implementation_notes: The slice now has passing browser E2E evidence in addition to unit and backend transport coverage.
Removing `/notifications` from route-level REST compatibility gating was required to make the E2E verification reflect actual product behavior rather than a harness override.
`/api/v1/system/info` remains a core part of the feature contract because the encrypted browser transport cannot bootstrap safely without it.
